activities.title: Explore Animal Jumps
activities.objective: Apply a central idea from 'Animal Jumps' through direct learner interaction.
instructions: Identify the information or pattern needed for the task.
Represent, measure, calculate or model one chapter idea using paper, objects or a simple digital interaction.
Record the result and explain it.
activities.success_condition: The learner's result is consistent with the chapter and includes a reason.

activities.title: Evidence Check
activities.objective: Distinguish supported ideas from unsupported claims.
instructions: Select two claims related to the chapter.
activities.success_condition: Every accepted claim has relevant chapter evidence.
